karty.priklad: Rhian oedd yn absennol yr wythnos diwetha.
karty.priklad_cs: It was Rhian who was absent last week (emphatic sentence with oedd).

extra.pozn: absenoldeb = absence (outside the coursebook); sentence from p. 163

karty.priklad: Beth dych chi'n feddwl sy'n angenrheidiol i gael ffair leol dda?
karty.priklad_cs: What do you think is necessary to have a good local fair? (meddwl → [f]eddwl after the dropped object ei; lleol → [l]eol and da → [dd]a after the feminine ffair)

extra.pozn: sentence from p. 167

sever.priklad: Be dach chi'n feddwl sy'n angenrheidiol i gael ffair leol dda?
sever.priklad_cs: What do you think is necessary to have a good local fair?
sever.pozn: north: Be instead of Beth (L9), dach instead of dych (L11)

karty.priklad: Edrychwch ar y llun o ffair flynyddol Abercastell.
karty.priklad_cs: Look at the picture of Abercastell's annual fair (blynyddol → [f]lynyddol after the feminine ffair).

extra.pozn: dyddiol = daily, wythnosol = weekly (L15); sentence from p. 166

sever.priklad: Sbiwch ar y llun o ffair flynyddol Abercastell.
sever.priklad_cs: Look at the picture of Abercastell's annual fair (blynyddol → [f]lynyddol after the feminine ffair).

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n ferch glyfar iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: She's a very clever girl (merch → [f]erch after yn; clyfar → [g]lyfar after the feminine merch).

extra.pozn: synonyms galluog, deallus (L13); in the book: the quiz Plant Clyfar Cymru (p. 165); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n dda mewn tasgau corfforol fel rhedeg a neidio.
karty.priklad_cs: She's good at physical tasks like running and jumping.

extra.pozn: corff = body, addysg gorfforol = PE (L12); sentence from the dialogue on p. 165

karty.priklad: Ydy dosbarthiadau Cymraeg yn groesawgar?
karty.priklad_cs: Are Welsh classes welcoming? (croesawgar → [g]roesawgar after yn)
karty.mnemo: croeso (welcome) + -gar (fond of): fond of welcoming people.

extra.pozn: the ending -gar = fond of, inclined to (croesawgar, gweithgar); sentence from p. 161

karty.priklad: Pwy sy'n gyfrifol am y trefniadau?
karty.priklad_cs: Who's responsible for the arrangements? (cyfrifol → [g]yfrifol after 'n)
karty.mnemo: cyfrif (to count, account): the one who has to account for it.

extra.pozn: pattern cyfrifol am (for something); cyfrifoldeb = responsibility; cyfrifydd = accountant (L6); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n ddigon deallus.
karty.priklad_cs: She's intelligent enough (digon → [dd]igon after yn).

extra.pozn: dealltwriaeth = understanding (L11); sentence from the dialogue on p. 165

karty.priklad: Paid â bod yn ddwl!
karty.priklad_cs: Don't be daft! (dwl → [dd]wl after yn)

extra.pozn: dwlu ar = to adore, to be mad about (p. 164: yn dwlu ar gestyll); sentence from p. 163

karty.priklad: Mae e'n fachgen galluog iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: He's a very able boy (bachgen → [f]achgen after yn).
karty.mnemo: gallu (to be able) + -og: someone who can do a lot.

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue on p. 165

sever.priklad_cs: He's a very able boy (bachgen → [f]achgen after yn).

karty.priklad: Mae Florencia yn enedigol o Batagonia.
karty.priklad_cs: Florencia is originally from Patagonia (genedigol → enedigol after yn, the g- drops; Patagonia → [B]atagonia after o).

extra.pozn: yn enedigol o = a native of; tref enedigol = home town; genedigaeth = birth (outside the coursebook); Florencia from the video Pobl Patagonia (p. 164); own example

karty.priklad: Dyw hi ddim mor weithgar ag Alan.
karty.priklad_cs: She isn't as hardworking as Alan (gweithgar → [w]eithgar after mor).

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue on p. 165

sever.priklad: Dydy hi ddim mor weithgar ag Alan.
sever.priklad_cs: She isn't as hardworking as Alan (gweithgar → [w]eithgar after mor).
sever.pozn: north: dydy instead of dyw (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n hoffus iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: She's very likeable.

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue on p. 165

karty.priklad: Mae'r parti mewn ystafell breifat.
karty.priklad_cs: The party is in a private room (preifat → [b]reifat after the feminine ystafell).

extra.pozn: own example

karty.cs: to do, to make do, to serve the purpose
karty.priklad: Does dim cadair arall, ond bydd y bocs yma'n gwneud y tro.
karty.priklad_cs: There isn't another chair, but this box will do.
karty.mnemo: tro = turn: it'll "do its turn", it does the job.

extra.pozn: am y tro = for the time being (L12); own example

karty.priklad: Gwyliodd hi'r gêm o bell.
karty.priklad_cs: She watched the game from a distance (pell → [b]ell after o).

extra.pozn: o bell ffordd = by far (o bell ffordd y gorau = by far the best); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd y dre yn dawel iawn bryd hynny.
karty.priklad_cs: The town was very quiet at that time (tawel → [d]awel after yn; pryd → [b]ryd as an adverb of time).

extra.pozn: as an adverb it usually mutates: bryd hynny (L17 has its own entry, no card there); hynny = that (L11); own example

karty.priklad: Edrychwch ar y llun uchod.
karty.priklad_cs: Look at the picture above.
karty.mnemo: uchel (high) → uchod; the opposite is isod.

extra.pozn: isod = below (L2); uwchben = above, over (L16); mainly in written texts; own example

karty.priklad: Ydy hi'n grac gyda fi? – Mae'n anodd dweud.
karty.priklad_cs: Is she cross with me? – It's hard to say (crac → [g]rac after yn).

extra.pozn: Robin Radio, p. 170; own example with the pair crac/blin from the box Y De a'r Gogledd L13

sever.priklad: Ydy hi'n flin efo fi? – Mae'n anodd deud.
sever.priklad_cs: Is she cross with me? – It's hard to say (blin → [f]lin after yn).
sever.pozn: north: blin instead of crac (L13), efo instead of gyda (L2), deud instead of dweud (outside the coursebook); careful, in the south mae'n flin gyda fi = I'm sorry

karty.cs: to call over, to drop in
karty.priklad: Galwa i draw ar ôl gwaith.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll call over after work.
karty.mnemo: galw (to call) + draw (over there): to call in on someone.

extra.pozn: Robin Radio, p. 170; short future galwa i (L4); dod draw = to come over (L6); galw heibio is also common in general (outside the coursebook); own example
